grammar.pattern: 不仅 / 不光…，还 / 而且…
grammar.explanation: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力 states both features. 不光 introduces a similar addition, often conversational. The addition does not cancel the first claim; do not infer absent benefits.

examples.zh: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力。
examples.py: bù jǐn yǒu yuè dú , ér qiě yǒu tīng lì .
examples.en: There is reading and also listening.

examples.zh: 她不光看课程，还问了学费。
examples.py: tā bù guāng kàn kè chéng , hái wèn le xué fèi .
examples.en: She looked at courses and also asked tuition.

examples.zh: 不只是面积，还要看内容。
examples.py: bù zhǐ shì miàn jī , hái yào kàn nèi róng .
examples.en: Look at content as well as area.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不仅有阅读，所以没有听力。
commonMistakes.right: 不仅有阅读，而且有听力。
commonMistakes.why: The added feature is included, not denied.

grammar.explanation: 不是这门，就是那门 frames a limited alternative: one or the other. It does not by itself tell which was chosen. Distinguish 不是A而是B which explicitly rejects A and selects B. The speaker’s framing need not exhaust all real-world options.

examples.py: bù shì zhè mén , jiù shì nà mén .
examples.en: It is either this course or that one.

examples.zh: 她周末不是读书，就是听课。
examples.py: tā zhōu mò bù shì dú shū , jiù shì tīng kè .

examples.py: bù shì zhōu liù , jiù shì zhōu rì , jù tǐ hái méi dìng .
examples.en: Either Saturday or Sunday; the exact day is undecided.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不是这门就是那门，说明已经选这门。
commonMistakes.right: 这句话还没说明选了哪门。
commonMistakes.why: Alternatives are not a completed choice.

dialogue.title: Two courses, no decision
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 李老师说不是这门，就是那门。已经选了吗？
lines.py: lǐ lǎo shī shuō bù shì zhè mén , jiù shì nà mén . yǐ jīng xuǎn le ma ?
lines.en: Teacher Li said either this course or that one. Has a choice been made?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没。两门当中还要看专业和学费。
lines.py: hái méi . liǎng mén dāng zhōng hái yào kàn zhuān yè hé xué fèi .
lines.en: Not yet. We must consider majors and tuition between the two.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这所研究所不仅有阅读，而且有听力，还能结合交流。
lines.py: zhè suǒ yán jiū suǒ bù jǐn yǒu yuè dú , ér qiě yǒu tīng lì , hái néng jié hé jiāo liú .
lines.en: This institute has reading and listening and can combine them with exchanges.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 面积很大就比较好吗？
lines.py: miàn jī hěn dà jiù bǐ jiào hǎo ma ?
lines.en: Is a large area better?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不能这样说。两米是长度，平方米才是面积单位。较难也要说明比较。
lines.py: bù néng zhè yàng shuō . liǎng mǐ shì cháng dù , píng fāng mǐ cái shì miàn jī dān wèi . jiào nán yě yào shuō míng bǐ jiào .
lines.en: Not necessarily. Metres measure length; square metres measure area. Comparative difficulty needs a stated comparison.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，三天内问清楚。有空儿再一起看，不替她选。
lines.py: hǎo , sān tiān nèi wèn qīng chǔ . yǒu kòngr zài yì qǐ kàn , bù tì tā xuǎn .
lines.en: Good; ask within three days. Review together when free, without choosing for her.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 中文系的专业与一所学校、研究所和所长是不同概念，室还要看用途。
lines.py: zhōng wén xì de zhuān yè yǔ yī suǒ xué xiào , yán jiū suǒ hé suǒ zhǎng shì bù tóng gài niàn , shì hái yào kàn yòng tú .
lines.en: A Chinese department major differs from a school, institute and director; check a room’s purpose.

lines.zh: 外文材料要注明语言，留学信息要注明年份；适应新课程需要时间。
lines.py: wài wén cái liào yào zhù míng yǔ yán , liú xué xìn xī yào zhù míng nián fèn ; shì yìng xīn kè chéng xū yào shí jiān .
lines.en: State a language for foreign-language material and year for study-abroad information; adapting takes time.

lines.zh: 公民身份、老百姓的意见与课程资格不能混在一起。老太太和老头儿的称呼也看关系。
lines.py: gōng mín shēn fèn , lǎo bǎi xìng de yì jiàn yǔ kè chéng zī gé bù néng hùn zài yì qǐ . lǎo tài tai hé lǎo tóur de chēng hū yě kàn guān xì .
lines.en: Do not conflate citizenship, ordinary people’s opinions and course eligibility; elderly address terms depend on relationships.

lines.zh: 比例先说明全部人数，面积先说明单位，内容是否合适再问本人。
lines.py: bǐ lì xiān shuō míng quán bù rén shù , miàn jī xiān shuō míng dān wèi , nèi róng shì fǒu hé shì zài wèn běn rén .
lines.en: State the denominator for proportions and units for area; ask the person whether content suits.

lines.zh: 某个选项如此介绍，并不等于已经选定。握手也不是代替报名；注意真实回答。
lines.py: mǒu gè xuǎn xiàng rú cǐ jiè shào , bìng bù děng yú yǐ jīng xuǎn dìng . wò shǒu yě bù shì dài tì bào míng ; zhù yì zhēn shí huí dá .
lines.en: A certain option is described this way, but not chosen; a handshake does not replace registration; attend to the answer.
